Use twoPhaseEulerFoam to simulate steady-state two-phase oil-water flow in a horizontal pipe.
The pipe has an inner diameter of 0.05 m and a length of 1.0 m, oriented along the X-axis.
At the inlet, impose a fixed mixture velocity of 1.0 m/s in the axial direction (1, 0, 0) using the fixedValue boundary condition type.
At the inlet, set alpha.water to fixedValue with value uniform 0.3.
At the inlet, set alpha.oil to fixedValue with value uniform 0.7.
Apply the noSlip boundary condition on all pipe walls for velocity.
At the outlet, set alpha.water to zeroGradient.
At the outlet, set alpha.oil to zeroGradient.
At the outlet, set velocity to zeroGradient.
Use the following material properties: water density 1000 kg/m3 and kinematic viscosity 1e-6 m2/s; oil density 850 kg/m3 and kinematic viscosity 1e-3 m2/s.
Set gravity to (0, -9.81, 0) m/s2.
